actual_same_scope_context_SQL:
SELECT a.resolutionId,coalesce(a.contentWithEquations,a.content) AS content,a.note,w.resolutionId AS contextResolutionId,w.content AS workingAssumptionContent
FROM Agreement a
JOIN edge e1 ON e1.src_id=a.node_id AND e1.rel_type='RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO'
JOIN AgendaItem ai ON ai.node_id=e1.dst_id AND ai.agendaNumber='5.1'
JOIN edge e2 ON e2.src_id=a.node_id AND e2.rel_type='MADE_AT'
JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=e2.dst_id AND m.meetingNumber='RAN1#100'
JOIN WorkingAssumption w
JOIN edge we1 ON we1.src_id=w.node_id AND we1.dst_id=ai.node_id AND we1.rel_type='RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO'
JOIN edge we2 ON we2.src_id=w.node_id AND we2.rel_type='MADE_AT' AND we2.dst_id=m.node_id
ORDER BY a.sequence LIMIT 10

MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem {agendaNumber:'5.1'}),
      (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber:'RAN1#100'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (w:WorkingAssumption)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai), (w)-[:MADE_AT]->(m)
RETURN a.resolutionId, coalesce(a.contentWithEquations,a.content) AS content,
       a.note AS note, collect(DISTINCT {resolutionId:w.resolutionId, role:'WorkingAssumption', content:w.content}) AS qualifiedContext
ORDER BY a.sequence LIMIT 10
